display.purpose: The homepage headline only; left-aligned, balanced wrap, at most 18em wide.

headline.purpose: Page titles and the editable lesson title; 28px on phones, 34px from 768px.

title.purpose: A lesson part's heading and the To remember section.

subtitle.purpose: Section headings on app pages (The syllabus, Recent lessons); 18px to 19px.

reading.purpose: Lesson text in a column of at most 680px; 17.5px at 1.65 below 768px.

body.purpose: Interface text, rows and panel copy, 14px to 15.5px; the document base is 14px.

label.purpose: Years under stations, captions, hints, table headers; 12.5px to 13.5px, sentence case, usually muted.

date.purpose: Dates under a board's name and the lesson span; always tabular figures.

board.purpose: Era names on full station boards (26px across, 22px down, 20px for a cause list's event); uppercase, Archivo at 75% width.

board-small.purpose: Small boards (14px to 15px) and the wordmark at 21px (app) or 23px (homepage); uppercase.

mono.purpose: Keyboard keys in kbd and raw block data only.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Popovers, menus, tooltips, side panel, bottom sheet, dialogs (light theme). Token --shadow-float.

shadows.name: float-dark
shadows.purpose: The same float shadow in the dark theme.

shadows.name: ask-halo
shadows.purpose: The homepage question box while focused.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default curve: popovers, presses, exits, details dropping in. Token --ease-out.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: The station board sliding along the route line. Token --ease-in-out.

motion.name: ease-drawer
motion.purpose: Side panels, bottom sheets, the phone conversation rising. Token --ease-drawer.

motion.name: pop-in
motion.value: 150ms var(--ease-out); opacity 0 to 1, scale 0.97 to 1, from the trigger
motion.purpose: Popovers and menus opening (.pop).

motion.name: pop-out
motion.purpose: Popovers and menus closing.

motion.name: panel-in
motion.purpose: Side panel entering from the right (.panel-right).

motion.name: panel-out
motion.purpose: Side panel leaving.

motion.name: sheet-in
motion.purpose: Bottom sheet rising (.sheet-up).

motion.name: sheet-out
motion.purpose: Bottom sheet dropping.

motion.name: scrim
motion.purpose: The 18% ink backdrop behind panels and sheets.

motion.name: enter-rise
motion.purpose: The phone conversation opening in place.

motion.name: enter-drop
motion.purpose: A station's details opening under its board.

motion.name: fade-up
motion.purpose: New content: a review card, an answer, a dialog.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Buttons and chips; touch screens also dim any control to opacity 0.6 on press.

motion.name: board-slide
motion.purpose: The route line's board moving to a newly chosen station.

motion.name: theme-crossfade
motion.purpose: Switching light and dark; skipped with reduced motion.

motion.name: top-bar-hide
motion.purpose: The lesson top bar hiding on scroll down.

motion.name: fill-in
motion.purpose: Every station of the card line filling at the end of a review.

motion.name: arrive
motion.value: 1.5s ease-out; board yellow at 22% fading to transparent
motion.purpose: A lesson part that just arrived or changed.

motion.name: flash
motion.value: 1.6s ease-out; ochre at 12% fading to transparent
motion.purpose: A changed part's heading.

motion.name: progress-rule
motion.value: 1.4s ease-in-out infinite; a 40% maroon segment sliding across a 1px rule
motion.purpose: Loading and streaming.

motion.name: wait-plate
motion.purpose: The era's plate while a lesson is on its way.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animations and transitions 0.01ms; overlays fade over 120ms instead
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce. The slideshow waits paused on its first frame.

narrative.overview:
Chronicle is a plain, familiar study app with one drawing of its own. Everything a student works with (the sidebar, tabs, buttons, the question box, ruled tables, reading text) looks the way a calm notes app looks: white pages on a light grey frame, near-black ink, neutral greys, standard controls. The one ornament is time. Wherever the product shows a sequence, it draws the same 3px ink line with round stations: open where nothing has happened yet, filled where it has, and the current one on a square yellow station board lettered in narrow, heavy capitals. The syllabus, the parts of a lesson, the day's review cards, a cause map on a phone and the homepage slideshow's ruler are all this one line.

Density is moderate and readable: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next everywhere (chosen for legibility, not character), 14px to 15.5px for interface text and 19px for lesson reading. Colour is spent sparingly and always means something: railway maroon for what you can do, station-board yellow for where you are and what is due, green and red only for settled or overdue, established or contested. Light and dark are equal themes built from the same token names; the dark one is a warm near-black, not an inverted grey.

The system refuses the "calm AI notebook" look (tinted page ground, soft serif display, mono kickers, rows of identical bordered cards) and the parchment-history costume. History's texture lives in the plates (the illustrated images) and in the board lettering, never in the page material.
keyCharacteristics: White page (#ffffff) on a light neutral frame (#f7f7f5); flat, with depth only for things that float.
One route line, 3px, in the text colour, with 14px stations; the current station on a square yellow board.
Archivo at 75% width, weight 800, uppercase, only on boards and the wordmark.
Railway maroon for primary actions, links and the focus ring; nothing decorative.
Tabular figures on every date and count; mono only for keyboard keys and code.
Standard controls at standard sizes: 36px to 44px high, 6px corners, 44px touch targets.
Motion is transform and opacity, under 300ms, with a quick fade in its place under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Station Board Rule
rules.body: Yellow is only ever a station board, a station dot or the due count: a solid fill with ink lettering and an ink border. It marks where you are (the current station, part, card, moment or event) or what is due. It is never a button, a link, a background wash or emphasis.

rules.name: The Maroon Acts Rule
rules.body: Railway maroon is for things you can do: primary buttons, links, the focus ring, the caret. Headings, icons and decoration stay in ink and grey.

rules.name: The Signal Words Rule
rules.body: Green and red appear only where they mean settled or overdue, correct or wrong, established or contested, and they always travel with a word or a shape (a filled, half or hollow confidence dot; "Contested:"; a hidden state word for screen readers). Colour alone never carries state.

rules.name: The Board Lettering Rule
rules.body: Archivo, narrow and heavy, appears only on station boards and the wordmark. Every headline, including the homepage's, is set in Atkinson.

rules.name: The Tabular Dates Rule
rules.body: Every date, year, count and score uses tabular figures in the reading face. Mono is for keys and code only, never for labels or numbers.

rules.name: The One Line Rule
rules.body: Any sequence the student moves through is drawn as the route line, the same way everywhere: across on wide screens, down the left on narrow ones. No second drawing of time or progress is introduced.

rules.name: The Flat Page Rule
rules.body: Nothing on the page casts a shadow. Panels, the review panel, the answer box and tables are separated by tone and 1px rules; the float shadow is reserved for things that open over the page.

rules.name: The Square Board Rule
rules.body: A board never gets rounded corners, a shadow or a gradient. Its square edge and ink border are what make it read as a board among rounded controls.

rules.name: The Under-300ms Rule
rules.body: Interface motion stays under 300ms and moves only transform and opacity. Anything longer is ambient (an arrival glow, a slow plate) and never blocks the student.

dos: Do draw any sequence a student moves through as the route line: a 3px ink line, 14px stations with a 3px ink border, open for not yet, filled for done, the current one larger and yellow.
Do name the current station, part, card or moment on a square yellow board (#f2c230) with Archivo board lettering and its dates beneath in bold tabular figures.
Do build pages from white (#ffffff) on frame grey (#f7f7f5), with 1px rules (#e6e5e1) between rows and frame-grey panels instead of bordered cards.
Do make the one main action on a screen a maroon (#8a2b22) button, 40px high with 6px corners, 14.5px semibold, pressing to 0.97.
Do list lessons and questions as ruled rows at least 48px tall, the whole row clickable.
Do set lesson text at 19px with 1.7 line height (17.5px and 1.65 on phones) in a column no wider than 680px.
Do give every touch target at least 44px, and pad bars for the notch and home indicator.
Do pair every signal colour with a word or a shape: confidence dots, layer shapes, "Contested:", a state word for screen readers.
Do define colour only through the shared tokens so the dark theme follows without extra work.
donts: Don't use yellow for buttons, links, highlights, background washes or decoration; it is a board, a station or the due count.
Don't use a serif or display face for headlines, a tinted or parchment page ground, or paper textures.
Don't set labels, kickers or numbers in mono or in letter-spaced capitals; mono is for keyboard keys and code.
Don't lay out content as grids of identical bordered cards.
Don't put gradient fills on buttons, panels or page backgrounds; the only gradients are the legibility shades and the bloom inside the slideshow box.
Don't add coloured side stripes (a thick coloured left border) to callouts, notes or blocks.
Don't give boards rounded corners, shadows or gradients, and don't draw a second kind of timeline or progress bar beside the route line.
Don't put shadows on anything that sits on the page; the float shadow is for popovers, menus, panels, sheets and dialogs.
Don't animate layout properties or run interface motion past 300ms.
